model.name: planar-cr3bp
model.constants_source: GM_earth, GM_moon: JPL DE440 via https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/astro_par.html; length unit 384400 km and mean radii: NASA NSSDCA Earth/Moon Fact Sheets; time unit derived as sqrt(L^3 / (GM_earth + GM_moon)); retrieved 2026-10-18

parking_altitude_km.definition: circular parking-orbit altitude above the mean Earth radius

return_shell_altitude_km.definition: return-shell altitude above the mean Earth radius (400 000 ft entry interface)

perilune_band_min_km.definition: lower edge of the feasible perilune band

perilune_band_max_km.definition: upper edge of the feasible perilune band

perilune_altitude_km.definition: altitude above the 1737.4 km mean Moon radius of the closest Moon periapsis before the return (event); km via length_scale_km = 384400.0 km (nssdca_lunar_semimajor_axis)

lunar_encounter_time_days.definition: time of that periapsis after TLI; time_scale_seconds = 375190.2618946589 s, 1 day = 86400 s

lunar_passage_sense.definition: sign of the rotating-frame Moon-relative angular momentum at perilune

entry_sense.definition: sign of the Earth-relative inertial angular momentum at the return shell (+1 posigrade, -1 retrograde)

perilune_margin_to_band_min_km.definition: non-gating: h_p minus the lower perilune band edge

perilune_margin_to_band_max_km.definition: non-gating: upper perilune band edge minus h_p

return_shell_crossing_time_days.definition: inbound return-shell crossing time after TLI; time_scale_seconds = 375190.2618946589 s, 1 day = 86400 s

return_shell_speed_km_s.definition: Earth-relative inertial speed at the return shell; km/s via velocity_scale_km_s = 1.024546847401724 km/s (nssdca_lunar_semimajor_axis)

return_flight_path_angle_deg.definition: Earth-relative inertial flight-path angle at the return shell (< 0: descending)

return_vacuum_perigee_altitude_km.definition: perigee altitude of the osculating two-body Earth conic (GM_earth only, no atmosphere) through the return-shell state; km via length_scale_km = 384400.0 km (nssdca_lunar_semimajor_axis)

earth_periapses_after_encounter.definition: Earth periapses between the perilune and the return

targeting_residual_perilune.definition: (h_p - 1000.0 km) / 1000.0 km at the refined point

targeting_residual_perigee.definition: (h_vp - 38.0 km) / 10.0 km at the refined point

targeting_propagations.definition: propagations of the least-squares start that found this candidate

sample_count.definition: rows in trajectory.json: accepted solver steps united with a uniform grid

superseded_check_backward_max_abs_initia.definition: SUPERSEDED criterion, recorded and non-gating: max |s0_back - s0| over (x, y, vx, vy), normalized, of the backward integration from the exported run's shell state; the M3 design's threshold was 1e-07 (would fail). Replaced (user decision 2026-10-18) by the decomposed checks backward_integration_{along_track_time_shift_s, transverse_position_error_m, transverse_velocity_error_mm_s}, because the max-norm is dominated by a pure time shift (|ds/dt| ~ 3.4e3 at the parking orbit, so 1e-7 is a ~0.1 ms test)

backward_run_max_abs_initial_state_error.definition: max |ds0| over (x, y, vx, vy); diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the exported run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

backward_run_along_track_time_shift_hour.definition: tau; diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the exported run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

backward_run_transverse_position_error_k.definition: |position part of ds0 - tau f|; diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the exported run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

backward_run_transverse_velocity_error_k.definition: |velocity part of ds0 - tau f|; diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the exported run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

backward_tight_max_abs_initial_state_err.definition: max |ds0| over (x, y, vx, vy); diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the tight-tolerance (DOP853 1e-13) run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

backward_tight_along_track_time_shift_ho.definition: tau; diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the tight-tolerance (DOP853 1e-13) run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

backward_tight_transverse_position_error.definition: |position part of ds0 - tau f|; diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the tight-tolerance (DOP853 1e-13) run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

backward_tight_transverse_velocity_error.definition: |velocity part of ds0 - tau f|; diagnostic, not a validation check: backward DOP853 1e-13 integration (no events) from the tight-tolerance (DOP853 1e-13) run's return-shell state to t = 0, error ds0 = s0_back - s0 split into an along-track time shift tau (ds0 . f / |f|^2, f = ds/dt at s0) and the transverse rest

delta_v_margin_below_km_s.definition: non-gating: delta-v decrease/increase (below) at fixed phase and impulse angle to the first infeasible value (doubling steps from 1 mm/s up to 50 m/s, bisected to 0.01 mm/s, 31 propagations); outcome beyond the edge: perilune_out_of_band

delta_v_margin_above_km_s.definition: non-gating: delta-v decrease/increase (above) at fixed phase and impulse angle to the first infeasible value (doubling steps from 1 mm/s up to 50 m/s, bisected to 0.01 mm/s, 17 propagations); outcome beyond the edge: no_return_within_t_max

limitations: Planar circular restricted three-body model with a single impulsive departure from an idealized circular parking orbit: no lunar eccentricity, out-of-plane motion, Earth oblateness, solar or other perturbations, finite burns or ephemeris effects. A 'return' is an inbound crossing of a spherical entry-interface-like shell, not an atmospheric re-entry model.

Found by least-squares targeting (h_p = 1000.0 km, vacuum perigee 38.0 km) from a sample of map run gravity-free-return-map-2d-grid-v1 (samples.json sha256 ed13294de9b804213e4f0c5b5a7c0dec13ae2d602f45a0252a1964050f761824); every start is recorded in run gravity-free-return-search-v2.
Samples are the accepted DOP853 steps united with a uniform grid of 2000 times over [0, t_ret], evaluated on the dense output; the last sample is the return-shell crossing.
The backward-integration check uses DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13 without events from the exported return-shell state.
'validated' means the recorded numerical checks passed; it is not a new scientific result or a mission-grade trajectory.

checks.name: predicate_failures_run_tight_independent
checks.definition: number of the three integrations (run, DOP853 1e-13, LSODA 1e-13) in which the candidate is not feasible or has a margin below 1.0 km to the perilune band edges or 1.0 h to T_MAX

checks.name: tight_tolerance_abs_diff_perilune_altitude_km
checks.definition: |h_p - h_p_ref| in km; ref: DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: tight_tolerance_abs_diff_return_time_s
checks.definition: |t_ret - t_ret_ref| in seconds at the return-shell crossing; ref: DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: tight_tolerance_return_position_difference_km
checks.definition: distance in km between the return-shell crossing positions; ref: DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: tight_tolerance_abs_diff_entry_speed_km_s
checks.definition: |v - v_ref| of the Earth-relative inertial speed at the return shell, km/s; ref: DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13. Threshold 1 mm/s from Jacobi conservation (<= 1e-9 each: |dv| ~ 1e-9 / v ~ 0.1 mm/s at the same radius) with a factor ~10 for the potential difference across the <= 10 m separation of the crossing points

checks.name: tight_tolerance_abs_diff_entry_flight_path_angle_deg
checks.definition: |gamma - gamma_ref| at the return shell, deg; ref: DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13. Threshold 1e-3 deg: a 10 m crossing-point separation changes gamma by ~10 m / R_S + kappa * 10 m ~ 1.3e-4 deg (kappa ~ g cos(gamma) / v^2), a factor ~7 below

checks.name: tight_tolerance_abs_diff_entry_vacuum_perigee_km
checks.definition: |h_vp - h_vp_ref| at the return shell, km; ref: DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13. Threshold 50 m from the two-body sensitivities of a near-parabolic entry (~25 km/deg in gamma, ~1.2 km per m/s in speed) applied to the angle and speed thresholds

checks.name: independent_integrator_abs_diff_perilune_altitude_km
checks.definition: |h_p - h_p_ref| in km; ref: LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: independent_integrator_abs_diff_return_time_s
checks.definition: |t_ret - t_ret_ref| in seconds at the return-shell crossing; ref: LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: independent_integrator_return_position_difference_km
checks.definition: distance in km between the return-shell crossing positions; ref: LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: independent_integrator_abs_diff_entry_speed_km_s
checks.definition: |v - v_ref| of the Earth-relative inertial speed at the return shell, km/s; ref: LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13. Threshold 1 mm/s from Jacobi conservation (<= 1e-9 each: |dv| ~ 1e-9 / v ~ 0.1 mm/s at the same radius) with a factor ~10 for the potential difference across the <= 10 m separation of the crossing points

checks.name: independent_integrator_abs_diff_entry_flight_path_angle_deg
checks.definition: |gamma - gamma_ref| at the return shell, deg; ref: LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13. Threshold 1e-3 deg: a 10 m crossing-point separation changes gamma by ~10 m / R_S + kappa * 10 m ~ 1.3e-4 deg (kappa ~ g cos(gamma) / v^2), a factor ~7 below

checks.name: independent_integrator_abs_diff_entry_vacuum_perigee_km
checks.definition: |h_vp - h_vp_ref| at the return shell, km; ref: LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13. Threshold 50 m from the two-body sensitivities of a near-parabolic entry (~25 km/deg in gamma, ~1.2 km per m/s in speed) applied to the angle and speed thresholds

checks.name: jacobi_max_abs_drift_run
checks.definition: max |C(t) - C(0)| at 100001 uniform times over [0, t_final] of the DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-12 integration; a conservation check only

checks.name: jacobi_max_abs_drift_tight_tolerance
checks.definition: max |C(t) - C(0)| at 100001 uniform times over [0, t_final] of the DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13 integration; a conservation check only

checks.name: jacobi_max_abs_drift_independent_integrator
checks.definition: max |C(t) - C(0)| at 100001 uniform times over [0, t_final] of the LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13 integration; a conservation check only

checks.name: backward_integration_along_track_time_shift_s
checks.definition: |tau| in seconds, tau = (ds0 . f) / (f . f), ds0 = s0_back - s0, f = ds/dt at s0 (normalized rotating-frame state, unweighted metric); s0_back from a backward DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13 solve_ivp integration (no events) started from the exported run's return-shell state. With |a| ~ 3.4e3 >> |v| ~ 10.6 at the parking orbit, tau is in effect the velocity error along the local acceleration divided by |a| (a time shift and such a velocity error are indistinguishable): 1 ms admits ~9 mm/s along a. A reversibility bound, not an accuracy bound: departure errors are amplified through the flyby; 1 ms is 100x below the 0.1 s return-time threshold

checks.name: backward_integration_transverse_position_error_m
checks.definition: |position part of ds0 - tau f| in metres; s0_back from a backward DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13 solve_ivp integration (no events) started from the exported run's return-shell state. A reversibility bound on the departure position (position-only errors land here), not an accuracy bound on the observables, which are amplified through the flyby

checks.name: backward_integration_transverse_velocity_error_mm_s
checks.definition: |velocity part of ds0 - tau f| in mm/s (rotating-frame components); s0_back from a backward DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13 solve_ivp integration (no events) started from the exported run's return-shell state. Threshold 1 mm/s (~1e-7 of the departure speed) bounds reversibility, not observable accuracy: at the local sensitivities of the M3 candidates 1 mm/s at departure moves h_p by ~0.6 km and the vacuum perigee by ~10 km; observable accuracy rests on the forward agreement checks

checks.name: brute_force_abs_diff_perilune_distance_km
checks.definition: |min r2 (dense sampling, 100001 points + bounded minimization) - r2 at the perilune event| in km

checks.name: dense_samples_inside_return_shell_or_moon
checks.definition: count of 100000 uniform dense samples on [0, t_ret) with r1 <= R_shell or r2 <= R_moon (a missed earlier crossing)

checks.name: non_finite_sample_values
checks.definition: count of non-finite values in trajectory samples

checks.name: non_increasing_sample_times
checks.definition: count of consecutive sample times with t[i+1] <= t[i]
